name: pictures
title: Pictures
summary: Shows a picture from Wikipedia of what the resident asks to see, so Mary can talk about it.
instructions: When they name something they want to see, show it. If they don't say what, ask what they'd like to see; never pick a subject yourself. Then talk about the thing itself, the way a friend would: a fact, a memory, a question. Never tell them where to look or describe the screen. Go by the seen line, which says what the picture really shows. When they're done, put the picture away.

actions.name: show_picture
actions.description: Show a picture of the thing they named. Only call this when they have said what they want to see.

what.description: What they asked to see, in their own words.

actions.name: next_picture
actions.description: Show another photo of the same thing.

actions.name: close_picture
actions.description: Put the picture away and go back to Mary.
